old_caption: In the video, a person wearing orange gloves is seen outdoors, standing next to a wooden plank placed on a tree stump. The background features a white brick wall and green artificial turf. The individual is holding a scraper-like tool and is in the process of scraping or cutting into a can labeled "DAB", causing a white liquid to violently spray and splash out. The person continues to scrape the can, forcing the liquid out in bursts and streams. The scene captures the dynamic, splashing motion of the liquid as it is expelled, highlighting the contrast between the white liquid and the surrounding environment. The video focuses on the interaction between the person, the scraper, and the can, emphasizing the forceful expulsion of the liquid.
original_wisa_caption: In the video, a person wearing orange gloves is seen outdoors, standing next to a wooden plank placed on a tree stump. The background features a white brick wall and green artificial turf. The individual is holding a paintbrush and is in the process of applying a thick, white substance from a can labeled "DAB" onto the wooden surface. As they brush, the substance drips down the sides of the plank, creating a dynamic visual effect. The person continues to apply the substance methodically, ensuring even coverage. The scene captures the texture and flow of the material as it spreads across the wood, highlighting the contrast between the white substance and the natural brown tones of the wood. The video focuses on the interaction between the person, the paintbrush, and the wooden surface, emphasizing the application technique and the resulting visual impact.
caption: Against a white brick wall and green grass, a pale wooden plank lies level on a tree stump, holding an upright DAB beer can near its center. A stream of white foamy liquid already spurts from a hole on the can's left side at the start of this excerpt. It arcs onto the plank and drips off the left edge onto the stump below. On the left, a person in blue jeans and an orange work glove grips an orange multi-pronged claw tool and repeatedly drives it toward the can's side, making brief stabbing contacts before pulling it back to the left. Each contact sends the foam bursting outward in a wider spray, while between strikes the liquid resumes its steady arcing flow. Droplets scatter into the air near the can during the pokes and fall toward the grass. The can remains upright on the plank throughout, and the camera holds a fixed position on the scene.
